name: Cryotank Rogue
description:
About This Game

Fight. Adapt. Augment. Escape.

Cryotank Rogue is a brutal 2D twin-stick roguelike shooter set in a decaying cyberpunk world. Wake up in a forgotten underground facility and fight your way through procedurally generated levels filled with enemies, secrets, and powerful upgrades.

Every run is different. Every mistake is deadly.

Fast-Paced Combat

Engage in chaotic, sideview twin-stick shooting where movement is survival. Dodge bullet storms, unleash devastating weapons, and carve your way through enemies using precise controls with mouse & keyboard or gamepad.

Augment Your Body

Install powerful augmentations that change both your abilities and appearance. Stack enough upgrades and transform from fragile human into a relentless machine of destruction.

Loot, Explore, Survive

  • Discover weapons, armor, and consumables

  • Try out unknown pills and needles

  • Adapt your build on the fly

Every decision matters in a world where death is permanent.

Brutal Roguelike Progression

Face ruthless enemies, cyborgs, monsters, and bosses across multiple biomes. Death resets your run—but not your progress. Learn, adapt, and push further each time.

Style & Atmosphere

  • Gritty pixel art with modern lighting effects

  • Explosive combat with heavy screen shake

  • Blood, chaos, and a worn-down dystopian world
short_desc: Cryotank Rogue is a fast-paced 2D sideview twin-stick roguelike shooter set in a brutal cyberpunk apocalypse. Fight through procedurally generated levels, loot weapons and augments, and evolve into a deadly machine to survive permadeath runs.
